FY2025.opinion_text: In our opinion, the financial statements present fairly, in all material respects, the financial position of Sawaed Al Bina Contracting Co. as at 31/12/2025 and its financial performance and cash flows for the year then ended in accordance with IFRS as endorsed in the Kingdom. Emphasis of matter: we draw attention to Note 9, which describes that certified amounts of SAR 23,239,000 due from a government-linked employer were unpaid at the reporting date, of which SAR 7,667,000 beyond the contractual payment terms, and that the Company's claim for an extension of time on the related project is pending the employer's approval. Our opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.

Due from Sawaed Heavy Equipment Rental Co. (an entity owned by a partner) SAR 9,600,000 (2023: 4,100,000), being advances for equipment hire. Equipment hire charged by the related party: SAR 14,200,000.

request.body: We refer to our long relationship with Sandstone Harbour Bank since 2016. We have been awarded Package C of the Eastern Corridor Logistics Hub by Sharqiya Logistics Development Co. (SLDC) (letter of award dated 22/09/2026, contract value SAR 312,000,000, 24 months from 01/12/2026). We request a dedicated project limit as follows, in addition to our existing general limit of SAR 160,000,000:

facilities.purpose: Imported MEP equipment for Package C

more: Package B is progressing well and the employer has agreed in principle to our extension of time request. Our receivables are current and the employer is a government-linked entity with assured funding.
We offer the assignment of Package C contract proceeds to the Bank and the personal guarantee of the undersigned.

resolution.persons: Turki Hamad Al-Sawaed (Chairman and General Manager)
resolution.text: The partners resolved to obtain credit facilities from banks up to a total of SAR 300,000,000 (including the existing facilities), to assign contract proceeds of Package C to Sandstone Harbour Bank, and to authorise the Chairman and General Manager to sign all documents.

rows.name: Eastern Corridor Logistics Hub — Package B
rows.status: In progress (revised completion per EOT request)

clauses: The Employer, Sharqiya Logistics Development Co. (SLDC), a company owned by the Eastern Province Development Fund, engages the Contractor to construct Package B (warehouse blocks W1-W6, internal roads and utilities) of the Eastern Corridor Logistics Hub.
Contract price SAR 486,000,000 (lump sum, excluding VAT). Time for completion: 30 months from 01/03/2025, i.e. 31/08/2027.
Advance payment 10% against an advance payment guarantee, recovered at 10% of each interim certificate.
Retention 10% of each interim certificate; half released at taking-over, half at the end of the 12-month defects liability period.
Interim certificates are paid within 56 days of certification by the Engineer. Late payment does not entitle the Contractor to suspend work before 90 days of delay (clause 16.1).
Extensions of time are valid only when approved in writing by the Employer (clause 8.4). Delay damages 0.1% of the contract price per day, capped at 10%.
Performance security 10% of the contract price, valid until the end of the defects liability period.

site_visit.met: Turki Hamad Al-Sawaed; Eng. Ahmed Fawzi (Project Manager, Package B)
site_visit.premises: Head office (Dammam, rented) and Package B site (Eastern Corridor Logistics Hub)
site_visit.summary: Package B site active; warehouse blocks W1-W3 structure complete, W4-W6 foundations; progress behind the original programme.
points: About 420 workers and 38 items of heavy equipment on site, most of it hired from Sawaed Heavy Equipment Rental Co.
Structure of W1-W3 complete; W4-W6 at foundation stage. Management attributes the delay to design changes by the employer.
Extension of time of five months submitted on 14/04/2026; management says the employer's response is awaited.
Management confirms certificates are being paid 'with some delay' by the employer; it expects payment of the outstanding certificates before the year end.
Package C site (adjacent plot) not yet mobilised; mobilisation planned for December 2026.
